assessment.nobel_worthiness: A major modern poetic achievement: myth, fragmentation, and engagement with inherited Arabic forms have enlarged the expressive range of Arabic lyric across a long body of work.
assessment.attribution: Credit Adonis alone for a poetic oeuvre exemplified by Songs of Mihyar the Damascene and A Time Between Ashes and Roses.
assessment.maturity: The sustained development of a distinctive poetic language and critical-essayistic practice supports a mature, oeuvre-level citation.
uncertainties: Assessment of the Arabic-language corpus depends substantially on translation and on uneven access to the full poetic and essayistic oeuvre.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: His encyclopedic fiction has made systems of power, scientific knowledge, paranoia, and countercultural imagination into an unusually ambitious and formally inventive novelistic domain.
assessment.attribution: Credit Thomas Pynchon alone for the singular novelistic achievement represented by Gravity’s Rainbow and Mason & Dixon.
assessment.maturity: The scale, technical daring, and continuing coherence of the major novels constitute an exceptionally substantial mature oeuvre.
uncertainties: The comparative weight of the later novels relative to the canonical early work remains a literary-critical uncertainty.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Visionary, densely patterned prose makes memory, bodily experience, and urban imagination into a large metaphysical fiction, notably in Blinding and Solenoid.
assessment.attribution: Credit Mircea Cărtărescu alone for a fiction and poetry oeuvre centered on this distinctive imaginative project.
assessment.maturity: The recurrence and expansion of these formal and metaphysical concerns across major works indicate considerable sustained achievement.
uncertainties: The Romanian-language corpus and the availability of translations may limit equal evaluation of all parts of the oeuvre.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Her hybrid works make an original literary field from classical scholarship, lyric, narrative, drama, and visual arrangement; Autobiography of Red and Nox show both formal invention and intellectual intensity.
assessment.attribution: Credit Anne Carson alone for an oeuvre whose fusion of scholarly and poetic modes is the relevant contribution.
assessment.maturity: Work across several forms, with a recognizable rigor and imaginative pressure, supports an oeuvre-level recognition.
uncertainties: The relative standing of the more experimental visual and genre-crossing works requires broader corpus coverage than the representative titles provide.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The large poetic sequences and landscape-scale interventions of Purgatory and Anteparadise make individual suffering and collective memory into a forceful, formally enlarged poetic vision.
assessment.attribution: Credit Raúl Zurita alone for a poetic project in which page-bound and public-scale forms are integral to the contribution.
assessment.maturity: The sustained conversion of historical injury into varied memorial forms gives the oeuvre unusual durability and scope.
uncertainties: Translation may not fully convey the sonic, typographic, and spatial dimensions of the Spanish-language poems and interventions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Her dreamlike narrative worlds radically unsettle psychology, space, and causality, producing a highly singular account of fictional perception in works such as Frontier and Love in the New Millennium.
assessment.attribution: Credit Can Xue alone for an experimental fictional oeuvre defined by this persistent transformation of narrative convention.
assessment.maturity: A sustained body of formally uncompromising fiction suggests a mature and distinctive achievement.
uncertainties: Evaluation of the Chinese-language corpus is constrained by translation coverage and by the difficulty of judging stylistic effects across languages.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Her interlinked narratives unite communal memory, legal power, and inventive storytelling, creating a wide-ranging fictional world in Love Medicine and The Night Watchman.
assessment.attribution: Credit Louise Erdrich alone for a body of fiction and poetry whose connected social worlds are central to its literary contribution.
assessment.maturity: The long development of recurring places, families, and historical questions demonstrates sustained quality beyond isolated achievements.
uncertainties: A fuller comparative assessment would require wider coverage of the extensive fiction and poetry oeuvre.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: His compressed, oblique lyric has markedly renewed modern Chinese poetry, joining linguistic concentration with exile, memory, and historical pressure in works including The August Sleepwalker and City Gate, Open Up.
assessment.attribution: Credit Bei Dao alone for a poetic, essayistic, and memoiristic contribution centered on this reconfiguration of lyric language.
assessment.maturity: The long development of an identifiable lyric voice across poetry and prose supports serious oeuvre-level consideration.
uncertainties: Translations may not preserve the full density, ambiguity, and formal resources of the Chinese originals.
